source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.note: Sleeve-sponsor table lists Elche - MGS Seguros. MGS's own Informe Anual Individual 2025 (p. 34) confirms the Elche Club de Fútbol sponsorship among the ten teams the company backed in 2025.
source.quote: Three clubs – Elche and promoted sides Málaga and Racing Santander – have even agreed with the same company MGS Seguros.
